question: Can the existing exact macro expert provider run synchronously on gfx1201 fast enough to justify a tiled gfx1151-core/gfx1201-expert pipeline?
decision: Do not integrate the secondary provider or build the tiled pipeline. The discrete GPU's host-to-device payload service dominates before useful expert compute.

build.code_object_gate: PASS: libggml-hip contains both gfx1151 and gfx1201 bundles

hardware.candidate_prompt_provider: logical HIP 1, AMD Radeon Graphics, gfx1201, 32624 MiB

correctness.interpretation: The existing deterministic expert sentinel passed and live tokens matched. Full live logits were not promoted because the performance gate failed by 3.28x in the expert stage.

gfx1151_single_owner_control.topology: core, prompt experts, prompt join on gfx1151

gfx1201_synchronous_prompt_provider.topology: causal core on gfx1151; complete prompt expert provider and calibrated join on gfx1201; decode remains gfx1151

interpretation.measured: Storage and expert arithmetic are not the dominant regression. Moving about 110 GB of prompt expert payload from host staging to the discrete GPU adds roughly 61-62 seconds at the observed transfer path.
interpretation.inference: A tiled cross-device pipeline cannot reach 10 positions/s while it must stream this payload over the measured host-to-gfx1201 path. The synchronous arm failed before any overlap implementation was justified.
interpretation.next_action: Delete the default-off secondary-provider code and return to the single-owner gfx1151 production path.
